name: Windrose Capital
notes:
At Windrose Capital, we invest in the creation of industries that are a beneficiary of demographic growth in consumption, simultaneously transforming its modes of value-delivery underpinned by emerging technology platforms. Through our current Fund, we are focusing on early-stage companies from India which are raising a round of a maximum of $5 Million.

Although we are sector agnostic, our investment & entrepreneurial experiences in particular domains, have developed our disposition towards the following Tracks-

1) Fin-Inclusion (Both B2B & B2B2C)
2) B2B Tech: Enterprise SaaS & SME Tech
3) B2B Deep Tech- AI/ML, NLP, Computer Vision, IoT, Edge computing, and other embedded technologies 

However, there are some sectors that we don't look into like HRTech, EdTech, ConsumerTech, Food & Beverages.

Here is a quick checklist summarizing the points above:

1- The company should be registered in India.
2- Current round should not be more than $5 Million. If it is above $1Mn then a lead investor should be in place.
3- The company should be at an early revenue stage with demonstrated ability to monetize the same. 
Preferred ARR is at least $0.5M
4- The business should have the potential of growing at least 10 times in the next 3 years.
Fintechs, Deeptechs, enterprise SaaS are favourable, open to D2C
